market_summary: During the London session, broader markets exhibit mixed consolidation with a defensive posture. Currencies (EURUSD, GBPUSD) and crypto (BTCUSD) are compressed directly at their respective session Points of Control and VWAP baselines inside tight value areas, lacking RVOL expansion. Precious metals (XAUUSD, XAGUSD) remain capped below descending VWAPs inside their value areas after bouncing from session lows. The primary directional opportunity is on US100, which has broken down beneath its Session Low and Value Area Low with aligned negative CVD and structural weakness below EMA50.
